_comment: Hand-curated annotations for the Andamio V2 validators (Surface 2). Keyed by blueprint validator name (validators[].title.split('.')[0] in public/yaml/contracts/plutus.json). The machine skeleton (validator name + authorized actions) comes from the blueprint; THESE facts (layer, purpose, governs) are hand-authored and cannot be derived from the blueprint. scripts/generate-validators.mjs joins this with the skeleton and fails loudly if the key sets diverge. Layer assignment is fixed per the protocol-docs-redesign handoff. After re-vendoring plutus.json, re-run `npm run docs-validators` to regenerate components/protocol/validators-data.ts.

global/global_state.purpose: The protocol-wide registry of participant identities and their local-state pointers — the on-chain identity every course and project interaction checks.
global/global_state.governs: Governs the **Access Token** global state. Mints a `g`-prefixed global-state token per registered alias (datum `{alias, local_state_information}`); the user's wallet holds the matching `u`-prefixed **user access token** from the index policy. Records credential-claim attestations back into a user's global state, and moves or retires that state as users enroll, claim, and update.

global/global_state_ref.purpose: Bootstraps a new entry in the registry's index linked list so the global state stays ordered and append-only.
global/global_state_ref.governs: Creates a new global reference pair — the **index linked-list marker** (the `0x20` space-prefixed token in the index policy) carrying `{prev_alias, next_alias}` so each new alias inserts in order. This is the index/reference plumbing behind access-token minting.

ls_instances/instances.purpose: Registers a new instance — the on-chain container for a single course or project — and links its local state into the global registry.
ls_instances/instances.governs: Mints the **LocalStateNFT** (`LocalStateNFT`), whose minting-policy ID *is* the course/project identifier (the courseId/projectId), and the **Local State Registration** token that connects the instance's local state to global V2 state. `MintInstanceRefScr`/`RemoveInstanceRefScr` manage its reference scripts; `BurnInstance` retires it.

ls_instances/governance.purpose: The shared authorization registry for an instance — who may act as a course's teachers or a project's managers.
ls_instances/governance.governs: Holds the **governance token** (course-governance policy, token name = the courseId) in a UTxO with datum `{participants: [aliases]}`. The same validator backs both course teachers and project managers (the instance-admin role). `AddInstanceCreators`/`RemoveInstanceCreators` edit the participant set; `MoveNew` rolls it forward.

ls_instances/instance_provider.purpose: Authorizes minting and burning on behalf of an instance, letting a course or project's sub-validators issue their own state tokens.
ls_instances/instance_provider.governs: Provides the mint/burn authority (`ProvideMint`/`ProvideBurn`) for instance-scoped tokens — notably the **LocalStateToken**, the UTxO that registers a course/project and embeds that instance's own validator as a script reference.

course/course_state.purpose: Tracks each student's enrollment and progress within one specific course.
course/course_state.governs: Mints the **Course State token** (course-state policy, parameterized per course; token name = the student's alias, so one enrollment per student per course). The datum holds the student's completed modules and any active assignment commitment. `CommitAssignment` records a commitment; `BurnCourseState` retires the token on credential claim.

course/module_scripts.purpose: Manages a course's modules — the published units of learning content and the Student Learning Targets they require.
course/module_scripts.governs: Mints **module tokens** (module policy; token name = the 32-byte hash of the module's SLT list), held with datum `{courseId, allowed_course_state_ids, prereq_slt_hashes}`. `UpdateModule` revises a module; `BurnModule` removes it.

course/assignment_validator.purpose: Adjudicates assignment evidence — students submit, teachers accept or refuse.
course/assignment_validator.governs: Drives the assignment lifecycle on the student's Course State UTxO (it mints no token of its own). `StudentAction` submits or updates evidence; `Accept` (a teacher) records the completion that advances the Course State token; `Refuse` rejects the submission.

project/contributor_state.purpose: Tracks each contributor's enrollment, task commitments, and completed work within one specific project.
project/contributor_state.governs: Mints the **Contributor State token** (contributor-state policy, parameterized per project; token name = the contributor's alias). The mint redeemer carries prerequisite proof (courseId + completed SLTs). `CommitProject` commits to a task, `AddCompleted` records finished tasks, `SpendingBurnRewards` distributes rewards, `BurnContributor` retires the token on credential claim, and `AdminAdd`/`AdminRemove` are manager overrides.

project/treasury.purpose: Holds and disburses a project's shared funds and defines its tasks.
project/treasury.governs: Custodies treasury funds keyed by the **TreasuryScriptV2 token** (treasury-script policy) in a UTxO with datum `{projectId}` and the treasury validator's embedded script reference. `Manage` defines and edits tasks; `CommitFunds`/`CommitToken` add ADA or native tokens; `BurnTreasuryToken` tears the treasury down.

project/treasury_token.purpose: Mints the per-task treasury tokens that earmark funds for individual tasks.
project/treasury_token.governs: Mints **treasury tokens** (treasury-token policy; token name = a hash tied to the contributor_state_id) that sit in the treasury/escrow to back each task's reward. `MintTT` issues them; `BurnTT` releases them on payout.

project/escrow1.purpose: Holds task deposits in escrow and settles them when a manager assesses a contributor's work.
project/escrow1.governs: Custodies task-escrow UTxOs (datum = the list of task content hashes) plus the treasury deposits backing them. `UserAction` is the contributor's move; `Accept` (a manager) releases the reward and pairs with `contributor_state: AddCompleted`; `Deny`/`Refuse` reject the submission.
